info.description:
## Canonical API surface

All supported clients MUST use **`/api/v1/*`** paths documented here.
info.title: Community Backend API

delete.description: Delete a comment and nested replies.

patch.description: Update a comment owned by the authenticated user.

post.description: Vote on a comment with values -1, 0, or 1.

get.description: Fetch all posts across all subthreads, newest first. This is the only official feed endpoint.

delete.description:
Drop somebody who follows you.

The escape hatch that makes open following bearable: the same edge delete
as unfollow, with the pair reversed.
Unfollow somebody. Succeeds even if you were not following them.

get.description: People who follow this user, newest first.
People this user follows, newest first.

Counts plus this viewer's relationship, in one call for a profile header.

Cached, because this is on the path of every profile open and the database
is ~440ms away. A follow or unfollow invalidates it, so your own action
still shows up immediately.

post.description: Single-file upload; returns public URL for use in post/comment create.

Load comments for many posts in one round trip (Supabase single `in` filter).

Reduces N+1 HTTP calls from the mobile/web client when rendering a feed.

get.description:
List posts by user identifier.

Cached like the feed. This runs on every profile open and the database is
a continent away, so an uncached hit costs a round trip that the reader
feels.

delete.description: Delete a post and related comments.

patch.description: Update a post owned by the authenticated user.

get.description:
Flattened conversation for one thread (chronological), same payload as
``/{post_id}/comments`` — alias for Threads-style ``conversation`` naming.

Declares the same dependencies as ``list_post_comments`` and forwards them
explicitly: calling a route handler as a plain function leaves any omitted
``Depends`` default as the raw ``Depends`` object, not the resolved value.

delete.description: Remove repost marker for a post.

post.description: Create/keep repost marker for a post.
Vote on a post with values -1, 0, or 1.

delete.description: Delete a subthread and nested content.
